description: 固定Phase1及既有合法support缓存，B用解析Affine LocalRidge；C在actual B函数上用全列旧点零残差条件核注册，完整隐式梯度与固定坐标球优化类RMSCE；结构改动而非参数扫描。
input_identity_source: Declared cache/capsule/model/physical split metadata from the Affine config; no learned state, result or scoring file read
notes: Explicit same legal input matrix: four model/cohort rows, 160 parents, old6, new0/2/5/10/20, K1/5/10/20, practical residual/post_sync/noeq/25MHz; no data rebuild/revalidation.
Only R0 and R_CONDITIONAL_seq, no reset candidate, parameter search, historical adapted state, query or source samples/features.
B analytic Affine head; outer class RMSCE only. C freezes the actual B function, pads new columns with zero, and constrains residual at every old training point in every registered column.

Raw positive Gaussian kernel plus conditional free-constant rank-one term. Complete implicit gradient of A/B/D/F/E and all adapter endpoints, including nonzero sum_rows(G). No detach of old projection.
Fixed 4 accepted iterations with at most12 halving trials each, initial step0.125; radius0.5, actual-delta Armijo and nonincrease; final accepted state, no held/query feedback selection.

C final actual full-support B prior; each inner C prior refits old inner-train head at frozen actual U_B, without nested B training. Each outer support path fits its own B, never imports prior run state.

new0 exact B object reuse; K1/rank0 still close head without adapter updates; tau0 exact whole-input equivalence with all physical IDs retained. Non-SPD/illconditioned raw old Gram fails without jitter, changed bandwidth or soft fallback.

Constraint proves old training-point score preservation only; old query accuracy, new query accuracy and broad no-forgetting are not mathematically guaranteed. No promotion based on support diagnostics.

Ground A packet metadata/weights are not bound, therefore A and B-A remain null. R0/B0 is support fitted and cannot replace A. Full paired B/C/old/new/H/gap and K-by-new-count tables will be reported.

Three spectral diagnostics and two Cholesky factors per positive C forward are counted. Time/peakRSS/resident/minimum deployment/numeric buffers/RHS proxies are distinct; unmeasured satellite resources=N/A.
Complete detailed text and lossless arrays plus compact JSONL/CSV are preserved. Existing source-only Phase1/capsule/cache provenance reused independently from learned method state.
